entities.name: Erik Solér
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Erik Francisco Solér is a Norwegian former professional footballer, a former football agent, and former General Manager and Sporting Director of New York Red Bulls as well as a football commentator for Champions League and national team games on Norwegian TV on a part-time basis. He is educated as a psychologist.
